record_title: Kothe duality erases the singular defect in Huang's logarithmically monotone examples
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The elementary truncation lemma, the Lorentz--Luxemburg theorem, and standard Marcinkiewicz associate-space theory are classical and are not claimed as new. The full older literature on singular functionals and non-Fatou renormings was not exhaustively inspected and is the main residual source that could contain the general truncation consequence in equivalent language. The result identifies the Kothe/associate dual and biassociate, not the full Banach dual, and does not classify all singular functionals.
